run_instruction_endpoint: send an instruction to the robot via the /run/ FastAPI endpoint
reset_robot_endpoint: reset the robot to its default position via the /reset/ endpoint
stop_instruction_endpoint: stop the robot via the /stop/ FastAPI endpoint
open_grippers_endpoint: open the robot grippers via the /open_grippers/ endpoint
get_health_status_endpoint: get the health status of the robot backend via the /get_health_status/ endpoint
